question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a grey ball, Bob has a green ball, Claire has a blue ball, Dave has a black ball, Eve has a pink ball, Fred has a teal ball, and Gertrude has a brown ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Dave and Claire swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap balls. Then, Bob and Fred swap balls. Then, Eve and Claire swap balls. Then, Alice and Claire swap balls. Then, Fred and Dave swap balls. Finally, Dave and Bob swap balls. At the end of the game, Gertrude has the
Options:
(A) grey ball
(B) green ball
(C) blue ball
(D) black ball
(E) pink ball
(F) teal ball
(G) brown ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (grey, green, blue, black, pink, teal, brown)
1. Dave and Claire swap: (grey, green, black, blue, pink, teal, brown)
2. Gertrude and Fred swap: (grey, green, black, blue, pink, brown, teal)
3. Bob and Fred swap: (grey, brown, black, blue, pink, green, teal)
4. Eve and Claire swap: (grey, brown, pink, blue, black, green, teal)
5. Alice and Claire swap: (pink, brown, grey, blue, black, green, teal)
6. Fred and Dave swap: (pink, brown, grey, green, black, blue, teal)
7. Dave and Bob swap: (pink, green, grey, brown, black, blue, teal)
Gertrude has the teal ball, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
